release.title: Neutral Multi-Field Professional Search and Qualifying-Profile Governance
release.artifactSha256Location: Final delivery summary after immutable ZIP testing

changes.problem: The public directory searched only name, practice, and borough and organic ordering could elevate inquiry-eligible profiles.
changes.implementation: Added shareable individual/firm search across name, documented service, exact ZIP, city, state, professional type, documented language, documented service method, profile status, and current inquiry eligibility; changed organic ordering to query relevance followed by alphabetical order.
changes.preserved: Payment, sponsorship, membership, claimed status, verification, and inquiry eligibility do not secretly improve organic placement; booking and inquiry gates remain closed.

changes.problem: Plain-language searches such as car accident, custody, wills, or SSDI did not reliably map to documented formal service names.
changes.implementation: Added a normalized versioned practice-search taxonomy that maps approved synonyms only to documented profile practice areas.
changes.preserved: No practice area, specialty, language, jurisdiction, availability, or credential is inferred merely to create a result.

changes.problem: Result cards did not show when public sources were reviewed, and release summaries could not distinguish public records from complete qualifying profiles.
changes.implementation: Added source-review dates and a strict qualifying metric requiring identity/type, documented practice, business office, jurisdiction, and a dated non-secondary supporting source.
changes.preserved: Incomplete and secondary-only records remain visible with truthful labels but are excluded from the qualifying total.

changes.problem: Firm cards derived practices only from attached individual profiles, causing documented firm service information to disappear for firms without an individual seed.
changes.implementation: Added source-supported firm practice fields and unioned them with any attached professional practices.
changes.preserved: Only practices already documented in packaged source records are shown; no new profile or inferred specialty was added.

changes.problem: Complex filtering lacked active-filter visibility, profile-kind control, and actionable zero-result recovery.
changes.implementation: Added accessible advanced filters, active filter chips, profile-kind sections, loading/busy states, clear controls, shareable URLs, and useful zero-result guidance.
changes.preserved: No radius or travel-distance claim is shown without verified coordinates.
